title: The Last Glasshouse
author: Tamsin Eriksen
blurb: Silas Fairweather, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the demolition date arrives.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
